name: MagicBot Gen1
summary: MagicLab's full-size humanoid, and the first of a line the company builds almost entirely itself — over 90% of the key hardware, from joint modules and reducers to the dexterous hands. It runs a dual-mode architecture that separates slow task planning from fast reactive control, carries 20 kg and works a 4–5 hour shift. The smaller MagicBot Z1 sits below it.

sources.title: Top 20 China Humanoid Robot Companies to Know in 2026 — CNCPioneer
